usage.costBasis: CLI-reported list-price estimate (total_cost_usd), cumulative per session; not provider-billed
usage.finalMessage:
I added the `estimate <copy>` command; `help` lists it right after `renew <copy>`, an estimate records nothing, and `dotnet test Lending.slnx` passes (19/19, including two new L14 tests). The work and its decision records are committed.
Estimates use DEC-010, the fine schedule now in force (0.20 a day, at most 5.00), but returns still charge by the older DEC-003 (0.25 a day, at most 10.00). An estimate can therefore come out lower than the fine actually charged (0.60 against 0.75 for 3 days late).
I left returns unchanged because L14 says existing behaviour must stay the same; whether to move returns to DEC-010 is an open question for Finance and the Head of Lending in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: completed
